values.note: Broward County's fee schedule: $50 per site per night plus tax, including park admission and the dump station; pets $5 per pet per night. A $30 Veterans rate applies in November.

Per Site, Per Night $50'; 'Pet Fee, per pet, per night $5'; 'Veterans Rate (November), per site, per night $30'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('The campgrounds at C.B. Smith Park (954-357-5170; CBSmithPark@Broward.org; 83 full hook-up RV sites)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Wi-Fi: 'check with Park Office for access locations'. Restrooms, showers and laundry are for registered campers only.

Smith, Easterlin, and T.Y. park campgrounds only)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve by calling, emailing (CBSmithPark@Broward.org) or visiting the park office, 9 a.m.-5 p.m. daily; stays under 14 days are paid in full when booked. Extended RV stays up to 180 days in a 365-day period. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('Campground reservations must be made by calling or emailing the park office directly'; 'Extended-stay RV campgrounds allow a maximum stay of 180 days within a 365-day period'; check-in/out times) + https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('extended stays are allowed for up to 180 days for RV sites'), read 2026-10-21

note: Broward County Parks campground at C.B. Smith Park in Pembroke Pines; paved sites with picnic tables, 30/50-amp. Heated pool, clubhouse. Tri-county resident discount. --Claude  RVs only: the county allows no tents here, and no cassette toilets or portable waste tanks (sites must connect to the sewer). No charcoal grills at C.B. Smith (county amenity list, 2025-12). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on broward.org: 83 full-hookup RV sites (water + sewer), open year-round, $50/site/night + tax (includes admission), showers, laundry, dump, Wi-Fi, reservations by phone/email to the park office, 180-day extended-stay limit. The county pages do not state amperage for this park (only that extended-stay sites 'may include 30- or 50-amp'), so electric 50 was left as derived. Note: dropped 'grills' (the county says no charcoal grills at C.B. Smith) and the restated site/booking/rating text.
